Answering about ORD-000252 op10 on CUT-01 — the first of its 2 operations.

  2026-01-05 00:00  release date [docs/05 A4] — its release date is 2026-01-05 00:00
  2026-01-05 07:00  the machine's calendar [docs/05 C1/C2] — CUT-01 is closed until 2026-01-05 07:00
  2026-01-27 11:15  no window long enough [docs/05 C3] — it needs 7h45m in one piece and CUT-01 had only 59m left when it came free at 2026-01-23 16:00

Not weighed here (docs/05): B3/B5 secondary and cumulative resources (tools, operator pools); B7/B8 sequence-dependent changeover; C4 time-window operation restrictions; F3 SameResource linkage.
